ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in and to each Deliverable upon creation. Vendor retains Vendor Technology as provided in Section 14.3.

input.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we commission, so we have flipped Section 14.2 to an assignment of Deliverables to Customer while leaving Vendor Technology with Vendor under Section 14.3. If assignment is not possible, we can accept Vendor ownership plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for us to use, modify, and sublicense Deliverables for our business.
input.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment; Vendor retains Vendor Technology.
